bibliographic-data.invention-title: FABRICATION D'OBJETS EN 3D DE FORME COMPLEXE

abstract.p: The invention relates generally to manufacturing of 3D objects, and in particular to apparatus for complex shaped 3D objects manufacture. Example embodiments included an apparatus comprising: a material deposition nozzle (304) configured to deposit a first material to form a first (332) and second pattern layer (336) such as to form a space with a cross-section that varies along the first (332) and second pattern layer (336); a second material deposition nozzle (312) configured to deposit in a space between the first and second pattern layer (332, 336) a second material (340) to form a complex shaped 3D object identical in shape to the space between the first and second pattern layers; and wherein the second material deposition nozzle (312) communicates with a material supply mechanism (324) configured to supply to nozzle (312) the second material (340); and wherein a processor (330) changes the amount of the second material (340) to be deposited by a nozzle (312) in the varying space between the first (332) and second (336) pattern layers.
